body:
Redline round 4

Final nit pass: reviewed only the nit fixes (0e4a537..370d5d8) for correctness bugs they introduced.

The round 3 fixes do what was decided. `textParts` now escapes a text whole only for a backslash directly before a backtick (`/\]\(|\]\[|:\/\/|www\.|[\r\n]|\\`/i`). Traced by hand, since the reviewer cannot run node: the namespaced case gives exactly the line pinned for app/n.vue:14. Its spans `<x-slot>`, `@⁠csrf` and `$a && $b` are left as written, while `\&lt;b>` and `\&amp;` are escaped outside them. Case 6 (`\`` before `<i>`) is still escaped whole. Escaping adds no backslash, backtick or trigger, so `readBack` still cuts the posted text into the same parts and the new round-trip mode holds. The README and `docs/running.md` costs, the R3-1 inline-link line and the R3-2 Deferred-line pin introduce no correctness bug. The earlier round titles posted on this PR hold no backslash, so changing the trigger cannot change how one of them reads back.

No findings.
